placements.title: Architectural choices define the system's technical foundation
placements.frame: what structural decisions are being made about the system's technical foundation?
placements.why: The decision to switch the analytics database from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB is an architectural choice about the system's technical foundation. The org's strata starts empty, and no existing category covers infrastructure-technology decisions.

placements.title: Replacing a core database for measurable performance and cost gains
placements.frame: what drives replacing a core database technology, and what measurable benefits justify the migration?
placements.why: Both expressions perform a single thematic move: Dave Quantum declares a database switch (src-1) and marshals quantified benefits — 10x query performance and lower licensing cost — as its warrant (src-2). The theme of technology migration driven by performance and cost is a subject future envelopes can keep feeding, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds this.
